goal: Deliver all 19 approved VII improvements as one safe, production-verified release without damaging approved design or behavior.

intent_model.literal_request: Execute the complete collected project, do not damage design or anything else, and contact Adir only after everything is live.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A coherent public and operational VII product where business details, units, galleries, contacts, reports and QQQAAA are accurate, usable and regression-protected.
likely_rejections: A fix that damages another world or viewport
Technical QA output that operators cannot understand

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: The complete 19-item inventory and every shared affected family.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No item can be omitted or represented by a sample only.

interpretation_rules.phrase: do not damage design or anything
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Preserve every approved invariant outside the requested deltas.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Before/after visual and functional regression is required.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Continue autonomously through implementation, validation, publication and live verification.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No final completion message before exact public evidence exists; only a genuine human-only blocker may interrupt.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Users see clear unit, availability and contact actions; operators see clear reports and QA meaning.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: One obvious action or one sortable/reporting choice in each state.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Complete the current booking, contact, moderation, report or QA action.

natural_destination: The published VII website and authenticated VII Control administration system.

facts.claim: The public runtime is vii.spaplus.co and current project sources distinguish targets from verified production truth.
WhatsApp must use an explicit supplier WhatsApp field and cannot be inferred from phone.
QQQAAA explicitly excludes accessibility and typography checks under the current user instruction.

assumptions.claim: The current release worktree contains the complete approved production baseline through the prepared v664 candidate.
assumptions.validation: Compare branch, commit, build metadata and live release source before publication.

assumptions.claim: Required supplier fields may already exist under alternate normalized or raw paths.
assumptions.validation: Inspect adapters, saved payload contracts and representative live/read-only API responses before declaring absence.

out_of_scope: Actual calls, WhatsApp sends, leads, reviews or bookings
invariants: Approved visual language and hierarchy remain unchanged outside requested deltas.
Existing search, filters, selected dates, guests, pricing context and navigation remain intact.
Phone and WhatsApp stay separate and use their proper source fields.
No stale availability is presented as final availability.
No existing public content or capability disappears without an explicit requirement.
No real external conversion action is submitted during QA.
affected_family: app/components unit, sleeping-arrangement and availability-calendar components
shared direct-phone, WhatsAppLeadButton, FloatingContactActions and online-booking controls
public review submission APIs and administration moderation routes
app/admin/catalog-sync controls and shared form-control styling
Hebrew, English, French and Russian routes using the changed components
desktop, 390px mobile, low-height, resize, reload and orientation states

requirements.statement: Show a separate complete unit card plus a distinct sleeping-arrangement explanation for every vacation suite/unit.
Map and display verified unit-level accommodation type data, or record the exact API gap.
Render supplier-defined gallery groups and names with correct membership and stable responsive behavior.
Clamp place description to 2-3 mobile lines with accessible expand/collapse and no contact overlap.
Group and order place attributes exactly by verified legacy/API taxonomy and suppress empty groups.
Allow public review submission without account login, queue VII reviews for moderation and preserve Biz automatic publication.
Keep verified place accessibility indicators in position without misleading statement or anchor links.
Use only explicit API WhatsApp numbers across all surfaces and hide unavailable WhatsApp actions.
Expose unit detail clearly and display total and available identical-unit counts in detail, sleeping and calendar states.
Replace visible VII brand shorthand with V without changing technical identifiers.
Unify Biz run progress counters around one persisted run identity and one monotonic source of truth.
Reconcile Biz WhatsApp and call totals, pagination, family mapping, date basis, deduplication and cache with authoritative data.
Present every QQQAAA event in plain Hebrew with impact and next action while retaining expandable professional evidence.
Modernize legacy-looking buttons, inputs, checkboxes, selects and related states across public and admin surfaces.
Show QQQAAA run level, progress, current simple-language check, counts, timing and professional detail.
Provide desktop and mobile floating phone/WhatsApp actions for vacation, event, hourly and supplier pages, and online-booking action for spa/attractions.
Make report headers sortable in both directions with correct data types, indicators, persistence, touch behavior and whole-result scope.
Add permanent QQQAAA prevention checks for every repaired family and the requested run presentation.
Publish only the exact tested candidate and verify the exact public release without design regressions.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative multi-unit vacation place with grouped galleries and amenities
acceptance_checks.action: Open, inspect, expand, switch galleries and select dates on desktop and mobile
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every unit, sleeping arrangement, type, gallery, description, amenities and available/total count is correct and no content overlaps.

acceptance_checks.setup: Signed-out public visitor and authorized admin
acceptance_checks.action: Submit a safe synthetic review payload without publication, then reload moderation
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Submission requires no login, remains pending in admin after reload, and Biz-origin published state remains distinct; no public review is created during release QA.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative pages with and without explicit WhatsApp, accessibility attribute and online booking
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect floating and inline actions on desktop/mobile and exercise safe URL construction without sending
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Only valid actions appear, use correct source fields, remain visible without overlap, and indicators are non-misleading.

acceptance_checks.action: Scan visible copy and render button/input/select/checkbox states
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Visible brand shorthand is V, technical identifiers stay unchanged, and no legacy browser-default control remains in scope.

acceptance_checks.setup: One new Biz report run over a verified period
acceptance_checks.action: Run, observe both progress surfaces, reload and compare summary/table/detail with authoritative response
acceptance_checks.observable_result: One run identity, equal monotonic counters, complete pagination, stable cache and reconciled family totals are shown.

acceptance_checks.setup: Full, medium and regular safe QQQAAA runs with at least one representative finding fixture
acceptance_checks.action: Start each level and inspect run/event/history states
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Level, progress, current simple check, passed/failed/remaining counts, timing, human explanation, impact, next action and expandable professional fields are visible.

acceptance_checks.setup: Report with numeric, text, currency, rate and unavailable values plus active filters
acceptance_checks.action: Sort each supported column in both directions, paginate, reload and export
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Whole-result typed ordering, clear direction, stable filters and matching export persist.

acceptance_checks.setup: Deliberately broken fixture for each new QQQAAA rule
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The new check fails with an actionable report and passes after restoration.

acceptance_checks.setup: Frozen release candidate and prior public version
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once, verify exact version, critical routes and responsive states
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Exact public artifact passes with a documented rollback identity and no high or critical issue.

open_questions.question: Do all requested unit classification, gallery grouping and identical inventory fields exist in the currently connected supplier contracts?
open_questions.resolution: Audit every documented/raw supplier response and implement verified fields; record exact provider gap for unavailable fields without inventing data.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, safe read-only/synthetic testing and production publication are authorized. No real conversion, destructive production action, AWS work, main-domain cutover or fabricated supplier/content data.
